platform: macOS arm64, native LibreCAD 2.2.2.6-alpha scratch application
procedure: Opened the AC1018-derived MLINE DXF and rendered its two component polylines.

A first attempt used accessibility activation on Keep Originals and resulted in a move; this was not counted as a copy pass. Saved as AC1032 and reopened. The first save reported six omitted objects from another DXF version.

Selected both existing polylines, activated Keep Originals with a physical-coordinate click, and entered reference (0,0) and target (10,0). The UI showed original and copied geometry. Saved to a new scratch DXF and reopened it in the native application.

Independent ezdxf readback found two input and four output LWPOLYLINE entities, each carrying LibreCAD_MLINE XDATA. Matching every vertex to the retained original and its (10,0) copy yields maximum error 0.0; both audits reported zero errors and fixes.
limits: This is a copy of an already-saved two-polyline MLINE projection, not proof of native MLINE object preservation or full-drawing losslessness.
The initial cross-version save reported six omitted objects; native rendering and copy of this projection only are covered.
The first accessibility activation result does not establish a product bug. Other MLINE profiles and platforms remain unqualified; no external or generated drawing was committed.
